name: limitswitcher
description: Feeds Claude Code's live usage to LimitSwitcher after every turn, adds /limits (every Claude account at a glance) and /swapaccount (this window on another account), runs the Jev compaction LimitSwitcher asks for before a swapped session goes on and before an old session is resumed (with the jev-compact plugin), and toasts when a used-up limit has room again.

statePath.title: LimitSwitcher state file
statePath.description: The file LimitSwitcher keeps its local address and token in (set when it installs this mod).
